title: Local Advertisers Begin the Move to Connected TV - MNTN Research

facts.fact: According to eMarketer (third-party), local brands increased their spending on digital video and OTT by 26.2% in 2021.
facts.quote: According to eMarketer, 2021 saw many local brands follow their national counterparts with a 26.2% increase in spending on digital video and OTT.

facts.fact: Nielsen's Media Markets segment the US into 210 distinct geographic markets used for geotargeting TV ads.
facts.quote: Created by Nielsen, Media Markets were a way to segment the US into geographical areas–210 distinct markets.

facts.fact: According to MNTN Research, CTV was the largest growing ad channel for local advertisers in 2021.
facts.quote: In 2021, CTV was the largest growing ad channel for local advertisers as they shifted some budget away from paid search and into the newest TV solutions.

facts.fact: On linear TV, specific inventory was reserved for local businesses, usually the last ad spot of a commercial break.
facts.quote: On linear TV, specific inventory was reserved for local businesses; usually the last ad spot of a commercial break.

facts.fact: According to MNTN Research, local advertising shifted away from paid search during the second year of the pandemic, per the Borrell Associates Benchmarking Study (third-party).
facts.quote: Borrell Associates Benchmarking Study noted local advertising shifting away from paid search during the second year of the pandemic
